source: Yahoo Finance | Yahoo Finance fundamentals (the feed the JSE pipeline already reads); merged into blank cells only, cross-checked against the file's own Revenue/Total Equity/CFO anchor | CRON r16 (2026-10-12): the H1 2026 column was already collected and stored in OMU__income.json for this security but never reached the JSE board, because the listing symbol is OMU.JO and the panel resolves .JO first. The same column is now published here, unchanged, so the newest period renders. Original per-cell provenance is in OMU__income.json. | CRON 2026-10-13: H1 2026 column taken from Old Mutual's unaudited condensed consolidated income statement for the six months ended 30 June 2026, printed page 96 of the Old Mutual Group Interim Results booklet (SA rand millions, so x1000000 here). Printed lines: Insurance revenue 37 371, Total insurance service result 4 085, Total net investment result 4 752, Total non-insurance revenue and income 9 787, Total non-insurance expenses (14 755), Share of gains of associated undertakings and joint ventures after tax 274, Loss on disposal of subsidiaries and associated undertakings (24), Profit before tax 4 119, Income tax credit 89, Profit after tax for the financial period 4 208, attributable to equity holders of the parent 3 889, non-controlling interests 319. Tie: 4 119 plus the 89 tax credit equals the printed profit after tax 4 208, which the stored Net Profit 3 889 and EPS 0.958 already reflect on the parent share. Income Tax is written as the credit it is, hence negative. Revenue, Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT) and Net Finance Costs were deliberately LEFT BLANK: an IFRS 17 insurance group prints insurance revenue, an insurance service result and a net investment result, so there is no revenue-to-gross-profit chain and no operating-profit line in this filing, and writing one would mean constructing a figure the filer never published.
